profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is a public company with the ticker CCC, headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, according to the profile data. Its CIK is 0001818201. The website listed for the company is calgoncarbon.com.

The text harvested from that site describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon company working on air and water purification. It describes FILTRASORB, a reagglomerated coal-based activated carbon, as proven by over 40 years of use in applications including TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial settings, and says the product is made in the United States. The site text does not mention CCC Intelligent Solutions or any AI product.

No products are tracked for the company and no MCP servers are listed. Litigation data associated with the company lists Illinois with a count of 375, and no individual cases are named.
